title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.27233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. translated_title: MMedAgent-Plus：跨模态、任务与工作流扩展的多模态医疗智能体
translated_abstract: 医疗工作流通常需要多个相互依赖的分析，但现有的专科模型和通用AI模型并不是为协调这些分析而设计的。我们提出了MMedAgent-Plus，这是一个多模态医疗工具使用智能体，它将视觉-语言规划器与18个领先的专科模型相结合，涵盖12个任务和8种模态。通过统一的工具接口，规划器选择专科模型、按顺序执行它们，并基于其输出综合生成响应。该规划器在来自32个公开医疗基准的208,928个样本上进行了指令微调，涵盖单工具和多工具交互的单轮与多轮场景。我们分别在保留样本上评估了工具编排、响应综合和端到端执行。MMedAgent-Plus在单工具多轮、多工具多轮和多工具单轮设置中分别实现了91.0%、98.1%和80.7%的工具调用准确率。在给定正确的工具输出……（摘要不完整）
tldr: MMedAgent-Plus是一个多模态医疗工具使用智能体，通过视觉-语言规划器协调18个专科模型（覆盖12个任务和8种模态）来执行复杂医疗工作流，并在多种交互设置中实现高达98.1%的工具调用准确率。
en_tdlr: MMedAgent-Plus is a multimodal medical tool-use agent that orchestrates 18 specialist models across 12 tasks and 8 modalities via a vision-language planner to handle complex medical workflows, achieving tool-call accuracies of up to 98.1% across various interaction settings.
